searchText: Lido have stated they'll have the ability for their permissioned operators to initiate consolidations by mid-2026 - right around Glamsterdam, give or take a few months <https://blog.lido.fi/lidos-roadmap-to-pectra-delivering-validator-consolidations-in-the-protocol/> Their stVault / v3 supports compounding validators now, but that's not where the bulk of stake is RocketPool aren't anywhere close to even thinking about consolidations Stakewise v4 would support compounding validators. I don't know whether there's a concrete roadmap for that. I see institutional users interested in 512-ETH validators when spinning up new ones, to get the compounding effect. Is 512 ETH the sweet spot to maximize compounding effects? It’s a sweet spot. The sweet spot may be individual. Attestant’s article on this is very good. Useful tool I saw to calculate the rewards: https://shayanb.github.io/EIP-7251-calcualator/ ACDE in 30m! Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1707 Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/88269836469?pwd=haUFXY28SNvw9pJ5CamxgMlMlghHac.1 YT: https://youtube.com/watch?v=wc40rKbl2LY X: https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1DXxyWPEoNZGM During ACDE there was a mention of using BALs in block production. I had a writeup on some thoughts around this a few months ago. https://ethresear.ch/t/rapidblocks-minimizing-merge-conflicts-in-the-block-building-pipeline/22590 I didn't have time to iterate on this too much since then, but happy to dicuss with anyone interested. **ACDE TL;DW** PSA: as mentioned above, Ansgar will be taking over ACDE during my leave, starting from Oct. 9 until EOY **Fusaka** - devnet-3 expected to finalize in the next day or so - devnet-5 live, all BPOs expected by next week's ACDC - We agreed on the deployment process timelines, I've updated my PR to reflect this: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/pull/1715, will merge tomorrow if no objections on PR **Glamsterdam** - Progress on BAL spec discussions, first devnet expected by the end of this month - EPBS breakout tomorrow **The Weld** - EL specs & testing repos are merging! - All info here: https://notes.ethereum.org/@danceratopz/weld-announcement#/ **EIP discussions** - Many EIPs discussed on the call (see agenda), mostly Q&A, no discussions about further Glamsterdam inclusions until Fusaka mainnet releases are out 🙂 I have answered some of the questions that were asked on ACDE about EIP-7932 and EIP-7980: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/the-case-for-eip-7932-eip-7980-inclusion-in-glamsterdam/25293/2

excerpts.content:
Lido have stated they'll have the ability for their permissioned operators to initiate consolidations by mid-2026 - right around Glamsterdam, give or take a few months

<https://blog.lido.fi/lidos-roadmap-to-pectra-delivering-validator-consolidations-in-the-protocol/>

Their stVault / v3 supports compounding validators now, but that's not where the bulk of stake is

RocketPool aren't anywhere close to even thinking about consolidations

Stakewise v4 would support compounding validators. I don't know whether there's a concrete roadmap for that.

I see institutional users interested in 512-ETH validators when spinning up new ones, to get the compounding effect.
